name: Home Depot DFC - Locust Grove GA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled entrances off the perimeter road into a fenced truck court; the campus is fully enclosed with truck circulation wrapping the buildings.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth positively resolved at the entry in current imagery; classified as remote kiosk/app check-in. Lower-confidence call.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large DFC campus — two large distribution buildings (the 2016 DFC plus an adjacent later building) share trailer yards in the Gardner / Locust Grove logistics corridor.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks on multiple building faces; well above 50 doors total across the campus.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large trailer-storage fields on the north side and a long apron south; 250+ trailers visible, ample dedicated drop yard.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock clusters on opposing faces of the main building.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Locust Grove / Henry County logistics corridor — edge-of-town industrial amid woods and farmland; Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate aprons and generous internal paved width support an express bypass.
